question: Which exact 3.1.28 v8 UI/platform records are accepted for a static-test Supervisor build?
prototype_hypothesis: Prototypes carried from the source records; addresses are the o66 pack's candidates, with the allocator pair corrected from the exact mm module.
callsite_evidence: mm_memalign_default 0xc12234c wraps mm_memalign 0xc1221fc with Umem descriptor dword_200936A8; mm_free_default 0xc11eee8 frees with the same descriptor.
launcher_load_app_info 0xc29a1f8, launcher_page_insert_icon 0xc29b21c and launcher_reset_order_info 0xc4fc508 are exact IDB names/strings.
The three LVGL object creators (0xc127924 / 0xc3269f4 / 0xc392c88) are not disambiguated; their bodies are aliases. The Manager registration path does not call them.
The remaining UI/platform candidates keep their existing o66 addresses and are only accepted for static-test builds.
ownership_analysis: No ownership change; records stay restricted.
unsafe_assumptions: LVGL creator/class selection is unverified; the Manager page widgets may be wrong.
recommended_probe: Run the installer in Mirage; open the Manager page and fix the creator/class addresses if it misrenders.
